Implemented P2-05.

- View reads now expose definition, owner, dependencies, and fixture dynamic/ordinary classification; connected mode returns classification as unavailable rather than guessing from SQL.
- `replace_view_definition` has unified diff preview, definition-text stale protection, typed confirmation, quoted view-name SQL, read-back verification, and `MODE_READ_ONLY`.
- Preview explicitly says proposed SQL was not parsed, validated, or executed.
- Updated capability matrix and task records. Dynamic views are identity-aware view SQL per [Databricks documentation](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/en/views/dynamic).

Verification: Ruff and mypy clean; targeted API/unit/SDK tests: 202 passed. Full `pytest backend/tests` was blocked at collection by the expected `jsonschema_specifications` `PermissionError`. OpenAPI export succeeded in fixture mode.

Note: sandbox policy prevented deletion of the task-local uv/pytest cache directories created for verification; they contain only cache artifacts.
